title: PassAResult
description: Pass A output: VL Classification + SPIFFER-Q Decomposition

classifications.description: Weighted scores (0.0-1.0) for each active VL framework (populated dynamically from frameworks.json)

primary_framework.description: Primary VL framework (populated dynamically from frameworks.json)

home_position.description: The base configuration the student returns to between movements (e.g., 'Lying on back, knees bent, feet standing')

tags.description: SPIFFER-Q tags: S, P, I, F, E, R, Q

segments.description: Segment IDs from the source text that this step covers

is_home.description: True if this step is a return to the home position

groups.description: Clustered step groups for the analytical table (5-8 groups)

label.description: Short label for this group (e.g., 'Bilateral push-pull with heels')

steps.description: Step numbers belonging to this group

description.description: Brief description of the movement exploration in this group
